question: Does the frozen large-model structured-extraction configuration show a reproducible calendar-boundary weakness on fresh cases, while retaining accuracy on ordinary within-month arithmetic?

baseline.substitution: exact replacement; no trimming or normalization

calendar_semantics.calendar: proleptic Gregorian; year 0001 through 9999; no timezone

corpus.nuisance_role: uniform ignored factual atom; no answer or difficulty content
corpus.presentation: DATE sentence then quoted code sentence; exactly one date output; offset is a literal in SUBJECT

C1.predicate: source and result have identical year/month; positive/negative five each

C2.predicate: positive: December to following January; negative: January to previous December; one year boundary only

C4.predicate: source/result differ in year; five positive/five negative; five paths include Feb29 and five do not

gold.independent: manual Gregorian month-length/leap-rule day stepping, no datetime arithmetic

freshness.isolated_offset_reuse: ALLOWED prospectively by operator clarification; not an experimental identity
required: fresh DATE output against historical DATE gold
no historical or new exact fixture duplication
freshness.source_scope: all valid date lexemes in historical input.text plus typed source dates; conservatively also exclude historical prompt date lexemes
freshness.gold_scope: all validated historical schema YYYY-MM-DD output values
history: G-EXTRACT1 all 192 scored/reserve rendered variants including unexecuted B

contamination.payload: unchanged accepted input.text plus canonical schema; NFC/casefold/whitespace and frozen tokenization; SUBJECT/system/record type/instructions excluded
contamination.ordinal_neutral: accepted ordinal neutralization, no new masks
contamination.historical: ordinary five-gram Jaccard <0.20; three-component collision prohibited; >=2/3 projection matches requires Jaccard <0.12; exact reuse checks also required
contamination.legacy_older_prompt_adapter: For G-ROUTE1/3 only: instruction subject is bytes preceding '. Copy names' if present, otherwise complete prompt. Normalize/tokenize and apply the frozen surface catalog. Never infer unavailable semantic graphs. G-ROUTE4 and G-EXTRACT1 require exact frozen suffix.
contamination.new_new: all 780 pairs have the same preregistered two-fact scaffold. Remove only five-grams invariant under replacement of the DATE value by a symbolic sentinel, never any DATE-containing gram. Nonempty residual Jaccard must be <0.12. Full fingerprint recurrence is explicitly allocated before authoring; distinct complete cases and typed tuples always required.
contamination.scaffold_rationale: The task demands one operation and a fixed request format. Apply the accepted declared-scaffold residual mechanism, not a fictitious ordinary-similarity pass. Report ordinary/shape/content similarity separately. No historical comparison receives this branch.
contamination.uniform_code_rationale: A second, neutral STRING fact keeps the shared historical-compatible source-layout projection distinct from historical one-fact calendar cases. Its value is ignored and uniform in shape across all strata. This is a prospective source-scaffold choice, not a prompt repair or a claim of identical fixture difficulty to G-EXTRACT1.
contamination.applicability: Every comparison records applicable controls; NOT_APPLICABLE is not a dissimilarity pass.

schedule.order: repeat 1 then repeat 2; within each repeat sort by SHA256('G-CAL1/order/<repeat>/<fixture_id>'), then fixture_id

metrics.fixture_success: exactly two completed semantically correct repeats
metrics.correlated_false_clean: both repeats false-clean; equivalent-wrong outputs recorded separately
metrics.primary_contrast: control fixture accuracy minus pooled boundary fixture accuracy; boundary false-clean rates minus control rates; exact rational differences; each boundary stratum always separately reported

interpretation.label: DESCRIPTIVE_CALENDAR_DIAGNOSTIC
interpretation.rationale: Ten deliberately constructed cases per stratum are not a random population sample. No validated practical effect cutoff or prospective error-cost function supports a categorical replication threshold. Report all exact counts and contrasts without qualification or causal claims.

taxonomy.rules: Apply only to validated returned dates: abs(returned-gold)=1; differing year/month; source-offset; source unchanged; for abs(offset)365/366 alternate 366/365 result. Omission pattern is gold+sign on a path containing Feb29. Insertion pattern is gold-sign on a non-leap February boundary. Multiple labels allowed, never inferred internal reasoning. Malformed and truncation reported independently.
taxonomy.reference: source, signed offset, frozen independent-agreed date, and returned date; never modify output
